newsitem.title: INDIA: India Congress to back any new coalition candidate.
newsitem.headline: India Congress to back any new coalition candidate.

text.p: India's Congress party said on Monday it would back any new United Front candidate for the prime minister's job.
The battle-weary Congress party has been trying to avert early polls after toppling caretaker Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's coalition government last week.
Party sources had said earlier that Congress would offer support for Deve Gowda's United Front alliance to allow it to make a fresh bid to form a government with a new leader at the helm.

Congress spokesman Vithal Gadgil told a news conference after a decision-making Congress Working Committee (CWC) meeting: "The United Front should choose a new leader," adding that "if they change the leader, we will support them and not stake our own claim".

Former Congress minister and CWC member Pranab Mukherjee said the party would withdraw the claim made by party president Sitaram Kesri to form a new government, after the United Front elected a new leader.
